test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 5: COURSE STRUCTURE MANAGEMENT (DELETION & ORGANIZATION) - Phase 1: Preparation
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher Navigates to Course Details from Dashboard
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with the email 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher' is logged into the system and is on the 'Dashboard Page'. The dashboard displays a list of courses, including one with at least one session and one file.
test_cases.expected_result: The system successfully navigates to the 'Course Details Page' for the selected course, displaying its information and available tabs (Info, Sessions, Forum, Files, Students). The course information, schedule, and uploaded materials are visible.
test_cases.post_condition: The Teacher is on the 'Course Details Page' for the selected course, ready to manage its structure.

test_steps.step: Click on the 'Introduction to Software Engineering' course in the 'Course List'.
